args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@gideon.sato Draft incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks, from #inc-vtg-hartford):

Subject: Hartford gate kiosks: incident timeline (Aug 3)

- First report: Aug 3, 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: Aug 3, 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in; dispatch confirmed it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: Aug 3, 11:07 AM.

Open items: status-page access for the procurement account is still being worked (ticket INC-4821). Kiosk 2 was left on for reconnect attempts while Carrowmere Cloud checks the Hartford gateway route.

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 10:42 AM to 11:08 AM, Aug 3.

I posted the draft as a reply in this thread. It covers the three times from #inc-vtg-hartford:

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosks incident summary (Aug 3), for Mateo's procurement team. Ruth asked for this version.

- First report: Aug 3, 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route from 10:51 AM, and asked that kiosk 2 stay powered on for the reconnect attempts.
- Kiosk 1 back: Aug 3, 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in; dispatch confirmed it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: Aug 3, 11:07 AM.

Open item: status-page access for the procurement account is still being worked, tracked in INC-4821.

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 10:42 AM to 11:08 AM, Aug 3.
